title: Seven Minutes in the Dark
tagline: The lights went out for seven minutes. When they came back, Ethan was gone — and so was $25,000.
location: A LUXURY AIRBNB · POCONO MOUNTAINS, PA
briefing: Ethan Walker, 22, vanished during a seven-minute blackout at a Pocono Mountains Airbnb. At 11:49 PM, $25,000 left his account. At 11:51 PM the front door was unlocked from inside. Four friends were in the house. Every one says they were somewhere else.
data_source: Case file (fictional bank and smart-home records)

note.caption: moved at 11:49 PM — and Ethan is gone

opening_letter.subject: My son is missing.
paragraphs: Ethan went to the Poconos for a reunion with his college friends. On Saturday night the power went out for seven minutes. When it came back on, he was gone.
His phone was still charging. His car was still outside. His wallet was on the living room floor. And at 11:49 PM, during the blackout, someone moved $25,000 out of his account.
Four of his friends were in that house: Noah, Maya, Oliver and Zara. Every one of them says they were somewhere else. At least one of them knows more than they’re saying.
The police think he walked away. I don’t. Please find out who he trusted — and who betrayed him.

suspects.name: Noah Bennett
suspects.public_bio: Ethan’s friend since high school. Loyal, sarcastic, quick to defend him.
suspects.opening: Detective. I was in the kitchen making drinks when the lights went out. I didn’t see Ethan leave. Just… find him, okay?

private.alibi: In the kitchen from 11:45 PM to 11:53 PM; a kitchen camera caught him just before the blackout.
private.secret: Borrowed $8,000 from Ethan months ago and still owes most of it. Ethan recently demanded it back, they argued, and Noah sent a $1,000 repayment three days ago.
private.red_herring_reason: An unpaid debt gives him a believable money motive.
knows: His glass near Ethan’s room was left there earlier in the evening, not during the blackout.
He noticed Ethan was missing at 11:58 PM; the group started searching at 12:08 AM.
private.personality: Loyal, sarcastic, protective, a little impulsive. Defensive and embarrassed about money.
private.breaking_point: Admits the loan and the argument when pressed about money.

questions: Where were you during the blackout?
Did you and Ethan ever argue about money?

suspects.name: Maya Rodriguez
suspects.public_bio: Dated Ethan until three months ago. Sharp, guarded, notices everything.
suspects.opening: Ethan and I argued at dinner, but we worked it out. I went to my room before the power went out. I want him found, Detective.

private.alibi: Upstairs in her room from 11:43 PM to 11:54 PM; the hallway camera shows her going in.
private.secret: At 10:20 PM Ethan privately told her someone at the reunion was exploiting him financially. At 11:32 PM he texted her: “If something happens tonight, check the account history.” She deleted the message because she didn’t want to be dragged into another fight.
private.red_herring_reason: Her lie hides evidence, not a crime.
knows: Ethan wanted to collect proof before saying who was exploiting him.
Ethan trusted her with confidential things even after they broke up.
private.personality: Confident, emotionally guarded, observant, intelligent. Avoids talking about private conversations with Ethan.
private.breaking_point: Admits the deleted message when pressed about messages or warnings.

questions: What did you and Ethan argue about?

suspects.name: Oliver Hayes
suspects.public_bio: Ethan’s roommate for two years. Calm, analytical, knows his way around any device.
suspects.opening: I was asleep upstairs. The blackout woke me, but I didn’t hear anything unusual. Ethan’s my roommate — whatever you need, ask.

private.alibi: Claims he was asleep upstairs and the blackout woke him.
private.secret: Triggered the prepared power cut at 11:47 PM, sent $25,000 from his own laptop using Ethan’s saved credentials at 11:49 PM, and unlocked the front door from inside at 11:51 PM so his accomplice Adrian Cole, posing as an investor, could lead Ethan to a car. Ethan is alive at an isolated rental near Lake Harmony.
private.red_herring_reason: Points at Noah’s debt and Maya’s argument; suggests Ethan moved his own money.
knows: He sent the transfer from his laptop
Adrian Cole drove Ethan to a rental near Lake Harmony
private.personality: Calm, analytical, technically fluent, manipulative under pressure. Gives detailed technical explanations to sound credible.
private.breaking_point: Only folds after both account_history and house_log have been presented to him, or both are found and Zara confronts him in cross-examination.

questions: Where were you during the blackout?
Who could get into Ethan’s bank account?

suspects.name: Zara Khan
suspects.public_bio: Booked the house and planned the weekend. Social, organized, persuasive.
suspects.opening: I was out on the patio, on the phone, when everything went dark. I booked this place — ask me anything about the house.

private.alibi: On the rear patio from 11:44 PM to 11:52 PM; her phone log backs part of it.
private.secret: Ethan recently gave her an expensive watch. She hid it so Maya wouldn’t misunderstand their friendship.
private.red_herring_reason: A hidden gift looks like a hidden relationship.
knows: Ethan had been thinking about ending his business ties with Oliver.
private.personality: Social, organized, persuasive, practical. Uncomfortable when asked how close she and Ethan are.
private.breaking_point: Admits the gift when pressed about her relationship with Ethan.

questions: What did you hear during the blackout?
Can you get the house’s own records?

evidence.title: Ethan’s account history
evidence.summary: Ordinary spending — and one $25,000 transfer at 11:49 PM, in the dark.

note.text: Ethan’s account: $25,000 sent to Ridgeline Capital Partners LLC at 11:49 PM, during the blackout.

evidence.notice: Fictional account records written for this case.

transactions.merchant: Airbnb booking (paid back to Zara Khan)

evidence.title: The house remembers
evidence.summary: The host app logged the power cut, a laptop that never slept, and a door opened from inside.

note.text: House log: Oliver’s MacBook Pro was online through the blackout and unlocked the front door at 11:51 PM.

log.event: Opened (Zara’s phone on Wi-Fi, outdoor access point)
Unlocked from inside — command from “Oliver’s MacBook Pro”

hints: Money moved at 11:49 PM, in the dark. Who in that house was really asleep?
Someone booked this house. Ask her what the house itself recorded.
Put the man who says he slept in the same room as the woman holding the house log.

truth_timeline.title: A quiet warning
truth_timeline.event: Ethan tells Maya someone close is exploiting him financially. At 11:32 PM he texts her: check the account history.

truth_timeline.title: A fake investor, a planned blackout
truth_timeline.event: Oliver’s accomplice, Adrian Cole, messages Ethan posing as an investor. Oliver trips the prepared power interruption.

truth_timeline.title: The money, then the door
truth_timeline.event: From his own laptop, Oliver sends $25,000 using Ethan’s saved credentials, then unlocks the front door from inside.

truth_timeline.title: A car in the dark
truth_timeline.event: Ethan steps out to meet the “investor” and gets into Adrian’s car. On the patio, Zara hears it pull away.

truth_timeline.title: Everyone hid something
truth_timeline.event: Noah hid an unpaid loan. Maya deleted Ethan’s warning. Zara hid a gift. Only Oliver lied about the crime. Ethan is found alive at a rental near Lake Harmony.

cliffhanger: Ethan’s safe. But my login… it’s been used before. Another account. Another name. Same 11:49.

next_mission.title: The Other Account
next_mission.description: Oliver’s credentials touched another unexplained transfer. A different victim. The investigation has only begun.
